scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with explicit localization, exact product-density calculation and normalization; a reproducible numerical and symbolic checker is included. No independent scientific review is represented.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic holds for each fixed integer dimension at least two, with spherical-area sampling on the nonnegative coordinate orthant; not a complete CDF or a uniform-in-d error estimate. The numerical quadrature is corroboration, not an infinite-dimensional or universal proof. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Logarithmic maximal-distance tails on positive spherical orthants
